video_title: Time For Pelicans To Trade Zion?

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Zion Williamson's potential trade market and future with the Pelicans
quotes.excerpt: Is Zion going to be in that line? And then what is the potential market for Zion?
quotes.quote: The big question when you talk to people around the league is, is Zion going to be in that line? And then what is the potential market for Zion? Those questions go hand in hand. I would tell you this, Zion is in shape, Zion is performing well. The Pelicans have a lot of problems, Zion has not been one of them, and one might say that makes this the perfect time for the Pelicans to explore the market for Zion.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: Zion Williamson's improved behavior and commitment to the Pelicans
quotes.excerpt: Zion has been on his absolute best behavior.
quotes.quote: From what I understand, and speaking to folks there, Zion has been on his absolute best behavior. Showing up on time, coming to camp in reasonable shape, playing hard, supporting his teammates, basically checking all the boxes. He is on his best behavior.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Zion Williamson's current physical condition in his NBA career
quotes.excerpt: He is in the best shape he's been in probably in his NBA career.
quotes.quote: He is in the best shape he's been in probably in his NBA career.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: Zion Williamson's contract status and non-guaranteed future years
quotes.excerpt: Next year's contract remains non-guaranteed.
quotes.quote: As a reminder about his contract, he has this year and next year, but next year's contract remains non-guaranteed.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Zion Williamson's potential to hit contract weight clauses
quotes.excerpt: I think he will hit the weight clauses that would guarantee that.
quotes.quote: I think he will hit the weight clauses that would guarantee that, if I'm not mistaken.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: The NBA trade market timeline and eligibility for recently signed players
quotes.excerpt: The trade market really doesn't even open for another month.
quotes.quote: The trade market really doesn't even open for another month when all the guys who signed their contracts last summer, or at least most of them, would be eligible. This is all very preliminary type of talk, but people are talking about Zion just because he is a talent.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Expectations for a potential Zion Williamson trade return
quotes.excerpt: There will be interest in Zion, but there's not going to be blockbuster type of return.
quotes.quote: There will be interest in Zion, but there's not going to be blockbuster type of return.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Comparing a potential Zion Williamson trade to the LaMelo Ball deal
quotes.excerpt: One thing that's come up on multiple occasions is the return that the Hornets ended up getting for LaMelo Ball.
quotes.quote: One thing that's come up on multiple occasions is the return that the Hornets ended up getting for LaMelo Ball, which was a talent upside swing. Charlotte clearly came to the decision that they wanted to move on, and that was a pretty good player in Naz Reid, filler, and a future first-round pick.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: Clarifying the details of the LaMelo Ball trade package
quotes.excerpt: I think there were two seconds, maybe three. Let me let me check.
quotes.quote: I think there were two seconds, maybe three. Let me let me check. I forgot there were three pick swaps in there. That's not terrible.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Front office consensus on the LaMelo Ball trade value
quotes.excerpt: The majority opinion was that there was a good trade for the Hornets and a big risk for the Timberwolves.
quotes.quote: The majority opinion was that there was a good trade for the Hornets and a big risk for the Timberwolves. Now, as we speak right now, it's a risk that the Timberwolves are surely glad that they took because LaMelo has played very well for them.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: Herb Jones's career-low offensive performance and contract extension
quotes.excerpt: Herb Jones is averaging a career low in points and a career low in three-point shooting.
quotes.quote: Herb Jones, who is starting in a year, he's starting his three-year $70 million extension. He's averaging a career low in points and a career low in three-point shooting, and a career low in minutes, I think.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: Benedict Mathurin's poor performance and injury status
quotes.excerpt: Benedict Mathurin, who wasn't like they spent big money on him, he is not played well.
quotes.quote: Benedict Mathurin, who wasn't like they spent big money on him, he is not played well. He's hurt now and he's not played well. He's shooting poorly and scoring poorly.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: The difficulty of playing Zion Williamson and Dereck Lively II together
quotes.excerpt: It's hard to play him and Zion together because they can't stretch the floor.
quotes.quote: Dereck Lively II, who they obviously famously gave away a lottery pick for, his numbers are fine, but he's not starting. And I think the large part of the reason he's not starting is that it's hard to play him and Zion together because they can't stretch the floor.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Herb Jones's defensive struggles and starting lineup fit
quotes.excerpt: Herb Jones is going to really struggle on the defensive end.
quotes.quote: Herb Jones is going to really struggle on the defensive end, and so it's hard to start him period.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: Comparing the starting roles of Dereck Lively II and Dereck Queen
quotes.excerpt: Dereck Lively II has actually started three games and Dereck Queen has started none.
quotes.quote: Dereck Lively II has actually started three games and Dereck Queen has started none. Jeremiah Fears has been pretty good offensively, defensively he is a target. But he's been pretty good. I think that pick is aging okay.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: Trey Murphy III's consistent trade rumors and lack of movement
quotes.excerpt: Trey Murphy has constantly been in trade rumors, but I've never actually heard anything about him.
quotes.quote: Trey Murphy has constantly been in trade rumors, but I've never actually heard anything about him ever actually getting close to getting traded.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: The Pelicans' high asking price for Trey Murphy III
quotes.excerpt: They're asking for first-born children plus.
quotes.quote: They're asking for first-born children plus.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: Dejounte Murray's declining production and trade value
quotes.excerpt: Dejounte Murray is a quality player who has been an All-Star.
quotes.quote: Dejounte Murray is a quality player who has been an All-Star, so you hear him sitting on the sidelines and waiting to be traded, it's interesting.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Dejounte Murray's All-Star status and recent performance
quotes.excerpt: He's been a one-time All-Star and it wasn't in his last two stops.
quotes.quote: He's been a one-time All-Star and it wasn't in his last two stops.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: The futility of demanding a trade without significant market value
quotes.excerpt: When you're a player who doesn't have trade value, demanding a trade, that's just like, who's benefiting?
quotes.quote: When you're a player who doesn't have trade value, demanding a trade, that's just like, who's benefiting? Are you? Is the team? I don't know, man. Nobody really benefits from a guy who doesn't have value making it public that he's demanding a trade.
